value.summary: Upgraded ASCP-T5 package use-proof selection from model-only selection to bounded provider-and-model selection. Default provider is AUTO_FROM_ASSF_LIVE_PROVIDER_CANDIDATES, resolved provider is alibaba-dashscope, unsupported providers are denied before package body read or provider call, and JSON output is ASCII-safe for Windows stdout.
